questions.question: Which review mode should I run for this plan?

options.label: SELECTIVE EXPANSION (recommended)
options.description: Hold the plan's scope as baseline and make it bulletproof. Then surface each expansion opportunity individually so you can cherry-pick. Best fit: new feature on an existing system with clear expansion opportunities (team views, default view, analytics).

options.label: SCOPE EXPANSION
options.description: Dream big — push scope up and propose the ambitious version. Every expansion is presented individually for your approval. Best for: greenfield or when you want to hear the full cathedral vision first.

options.label: HOLD SCOPE
options.description: Maximum rigor on the plan as written. No expansions surfaced. Review every failure mode, edge case, security path, and deployment concern. Best for: bug fixes, hotfixes, or when scope is locked.

options.label: SCOPE REDUCTION
options.description: Find the minimum viable version that ships value. Cut everything else ruthlessly. Best for: overbuilt plans or when you need to ship faster than the plan allows.

content.text:
HOLD SCOPE confirmed. Approach B (personal DB views, 7/10) is the implementation baseline.

Now running 0D (HOLD SCOPE analysis) and 0E (temporal interrogation), then loading the 11-section review.

**0D: HOLD SCOPE complexity check**
- Files touched: ~5 (migration, model, controller/router, UI picker component, tests). Well under the 8-file threshold. No complexity smell.
- Minimum set to achieve the goal: all four plan items are load-bearing (table, CRUD endpoints, UI picker, access rules adherence). No obvious deferrable scope within the stated goal — except the pilot measurement infrastructure, which needs specifics.

**0E: Temporal Interrogation**
```
HOUR 1 (foundations):
  What columns? name, filters (JSON blob), sort_order (JSON blob),
  member_id, project_id, created_at, updated_at, id
  What is the filter serialization format? Must decide NOW — blob
  shape is implicit API contract that's painful to change later.
  Existing filter state serialization: is there one to reuse?

HOUR 2-3 (core logic):
  Auth: can a member CRUD only their own views? What prevents
  member A from updating member B's view via direct ID?
  Update semantics: full replace (PUT) or partial (PATCH)?
  "Keep existing task access rules" — what exactly gates a
  saved view application? Re-fetch with normal member access?

HOUR 4-5 (integration):
  URL deep-link: does applying a saved view update the URL?
  Shareable link? (Scope question that needs an answer now.)
  Filter schema drift: what happens when a view references a
  filter field that was removed from the product?
  Max views per member per project: no limit = runaway storage.
  Empty state when member has 0 views — design needed.

HOUR 6+ (polish/tests):
  "Reopening after task changes" — test spec is ambiguous:
  does it mean task list refreshes through the saved filters?
  Pilot measurement: what event do you log for a "view reuse"?
  Where does that event go? Without implementation, pilot
  measurement is wishful thinking, not a plan.
```

Now loading the review sections.
